category.description: Filter by protocol category (e.g. 'Dexes', 'Lending', 'Derivatives', 'CDP', 'Liquid Staking', 'Bridge'). Case-insensitive partial match.

limit.description: Number of protocols to return. Default 20, max 100.

min_daily_fees.description: Minimum 24h fees in USD to include a protocol (e.g. 10000 for $10K+). Filters out noise.

sort_by.description: Ranking metric. 'daily_fees' = 24h fees (default). '7d_fees' = 7-day total. '30d_fees' = 30-day total. '1d_change' = biggest 1-day fee growth (%).

description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.059 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Returns DeFi protocols ranked by daily fees (revenue generated). Covers 1000+ protocols across chains — DEXes, lending markets, derivatives, stablecoins. Includes 1d/7d/30d trend context, category breakdown, and chain presence. Use to identify which protocols are capturing the most economic activity, screen for fundamental DeFi strength, or compare protocol revenue trajectories.
